01.title: 01. Stealth Dart Fighter
stepHints: Fold the two top corners down so the top edges meet the center line.
Fold the new slanted edges to the center line again.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down so its top edge lines up with the bottom of the plane.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!

Fold the two top corners down to the center line.
Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Bend one wing's back corner up and the other one's down (stunt flaps), then open the wings. Ready to fly!

Fold the plane in half backward along the center line.
Fold each wing down along the wing line, one to the front and one to the back.
Open the wings so they stand level. Ready to fly!
